instruction: Tidy up the desk: books go on the orange tray, mugs go on the cyan tray and the pen stands upright in the magenta pen holder.

attempts.code:
# Subgoal: Move blue_book to orange_tray
obs = observe()
book_candidates = grasp_candidates("blue_book")

# Choose a suitable grasp candidate (fits fingers, preferably across short side or highest score)
valid_cands = [c for c in book_candidates if c.get("fits_open_fingers", True)]
best_cand = max(valid_cands, key=lambda c: c.get("score", 0.0))

grasp(best_cand)

# Check holding
obs = observe()
if obs["gripper"]["holding_something"]:
    target_zone = obs["zones"]["orange_tray"]
    target_yaw = target_zone["long_axis_yaw"]
    
    # Calculate yaw for the book to align its long axis with orange_tray's long axis
    # yaw = target_long_axis + (gripper_yaw_at_grasp - object_long_axis_at_grasp)
    gripper_yaw = target_yaw + (best_cand["yaw"] - best_cand["object_long_axis_yaw"])
    
    # Carry to orange_tray center (orange_tray center: y is around 0.1277, mug is at y=0.2355)
    # The tray center or slightly towards negative y is free of yellow_mug
    carry_to(target_zone["center"][0], target_zone["center"][1] - 0.04, height=0.18, yaw=gripper_yaw)
    lower_until_contact()
    open_gripper()
    retreat(0.12)
    check("blue_book", "orange_tray")

obs = observe()
holder = obs["zones"]["magenta_holder"]

candidates = grasp_candidates(pen_name)
# Select candidate that squeezes across the pen's width (fits open fingers, best score/geometry)

    holder_x, holder_y, holder_z = holder["center"]
    rim_h = holder.get("rim_height", 0.08)
    # Carry above holder at safe height
    carry_to(holder_x, holder_y, height=rim_h + 0.15)
    
    # Lower pen into the holder
    lower_until_contact()
    open_gripper()
    retreat(dz=0.15)
    go_home()
    check(pen_name, "magenta_holder")

obs = observe()
holder = obs["zones"]["magenta_holder"]
pen = obs["objects"]["green_pen"]
table_z = obs["table_z"]

# Pick grasp candidate on the pen
candidates = grasp_candidates("green_pen")
cand = min(candidates, key=lambda c: c["squeeze_width"])
grasp(cand)

# Move high above the table first
hx, hy, _ = holder["center"]
rim_h = holder.get("rim_height", 0.08)

# The pen was grasped horizontally (finger_axis along width, side along pen length).
# To make the pen stand upright (vertical along world z), the pen's long axis (currently side)
# needs to be oriented along z. Alternatively, approach or side can be pitched/rolled.
# With approach=[0, 0, -1] and finger_axis=[1, 0, 0], side is [0, -1, 0] (horizontal).
# To make side vertical ([0, 0, -1] or [0, 0, 1]), we can set approach horizontal, e.g., approach=[1, 0, 0], finger_axis=[0, 1, 0] -> side=[0, 0, 1].
# Check IK with approach=[1, 0, 0], finger_axis=[0, 1, 0] at high position above holder:
z_target = table_z + rim_h + 0.15
ik_test = solve_ik(hx, hy, z_target, approach=[1, 0, 0], finger_axis=[0, 1, 0])
if ik_test["reachable"]:
    move_gripper(hx, hy, z_target, approach=[1, 0, 0], finger_axis=[0, 1, 0], path="joint")
else:
    move_gripper(hx, hy, z_target, approach=[0, 1, 0], finger_axis=[1, 0, 0], path="joint")

# Lower pen vertically into the holder
lower_until_contact()
open_gripper()
retreat(dz=0.15)
go_home()
check("green_pen", "magenta_holder")

obs = observe()

# Look at current state: gripper is already holding something!
# Check gripper state:
# "gripper": {"width": 0.0859, "closed_command": true, "holding_something": true}
# "end_effector": {"position": [0.0471, 0.1896, 0.8699], "yaw": 2.813}
# The gripper is already at magenta_holder, holding the pen or blocked!
# If already holding the pen, open gripper, retreat, go home and check.
if obs["gripper"]["holding_something"]:
    open_gripper()
    retreat(dz=0.15)
    go_home()
    res = check("green_pen", "magenta_holder")
    if not res.get("satisfied", False):
        obs = observe()

# If not satisfied and not holding, grasp the pen cleanly
if not obs["gripper"]["holding_something"]:
    pen = obs["objects"]["green_pen"]
    holder = obs["zones"]["magenta_holder"]
    candidates = grasp_candidates("green_pen")
    # Choose candidate near pen's top height to grasp vertically or insert easily
    cand = min(candidates, key=lambda c: abs(c["height"] - pen["height"]))
    grasp(cand)
    hx, hy, _ = holder["center"]
    carry_to(hx, hy, height=holder.get("rim_height", 0.08) + 0.12)
    lower_until_contact()
    open_gripper()
    retreat(dz=0.15)
    go_home()
    check("green_pen", "magenta_holder")
